caption: A coat lies on a table; an arm slides into one sleeve and the hand emerges from the cuff.

sa.check: A coat lies on a table.
An arm slides into one sleeve.
The hand emerges from the cuff.
The arm enters first and the hand emerges after.

pc.expect: The hand appears at the cuff only after the arm has travelled the sleeve's length, and it is the same hand.
pc.fail: The hand appears before the arm is in; or appears elsewhere; or two hands appear.

pc.expect: The sleeve bulges as the arm passes, and the arm does not show through the fabric.
pc.fail: The arm shows through; or passes through the sleeve wall; or the sleeve passes through the arm.

pc.expect: The arm and hand keep their shape and the sleeve keeps its length.
pc.fail: The arm stretches; or the sleeve grows; or the hand changes.

pc.expect: The fabric bulges and shifts softly.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or stretches like elastic; or tears.

pc.expect: One arm and one coat keep their number.
pc.fail: The arm detaches; or a second coat appears; or the arm merges with the coat.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The coat's colour and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The coat changes colour; or the table changes; or the background rearranges.

note: The arm is the physics here: it is what travels the sleeve. The person is not judged.
